name: Szakály (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of light grey over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Szakály: a blue, red and green shield with antlers, a church, a bunch of grapes and ears of grain, with grey mantling, above a scroll inscribed SZAKÁLY.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Szakály arms with mantling and scroll
